metadata.method: Authenticated OAQ signed-history boundary probe using the documented Data Lake handshake. Tested 31 old/deep CPCB station IDs against annual aggregate paths for 2009, 2011, 2013, 2015, 2017, 2019 and every year from 2020 through 2026. Annual 2026 returned data from 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-23 for all 31 tested stations; every tested pre-2026 annual path returned not found. For 15 stations, monthly aggregate paths returned data for 2026-01 through 2026-06 and returned not found for tested 2025 months. For 8 stations, daily raw checks returned data for tested 2026 dates and did not find tested 2025 dates; plain numeric IDs worked, while site_ prefixed IDs did not. API token and signed URLs are not stored.
